limitations: Two fresh VNET TCP stacks on one FreeBSD kernel and one macOS source; configuration-reserved coverage is not physically independent held-out validation
Exact binomial confidence bounds and numerical gates are conditional on IID Bernoulli sampling, which this experiment cannot establish
Strict complete-pair inference stays unresolved under loss; all planned invalid, missing and unresolved outcomes remain in denominators
Direct private IPv4/IPv6 only; Linux corpus supplies proxy/NAT fixtures; no BSD NAT, proxy, routed IPv6 or native FreeBSD Nyxr backend validation
Concurrent fixtures share source CPU and host resources; per-child CPU/RSS and RTT are descriptive, not calibrated performance
Original VM TCP setting/default routes/firewall rules remain unchanged; only temporary VNET rules, links, read-only jail mounts and owned modules are removed
